title: P2 funding-carry and P3 swing economics screen on the frozen 30-day benchmark (descriptive measurement, NOT a strategy)
author_lane: independent 4th agent (owner-directed); filed to manager for review
role: Pre-decision economics screen informing the owner's 10-day-capture choice (SWEEP-2026-10-16 blocker #1). Creates NO strategy, NO candidate, consumes NO PIVOT-01 attempt budget. Mirrors STUDY-01's role for the taker-scalp thesis: measure the economics on repo bytes before committing capture effort.

data_frozen.source: datasets/benchmark_30d.toml manifest 9008ba92 (transform v2 causal; v1 close-at-open lookahead refused by the repo reader)
data_frozen.funding_note: Settlement-grade funding parquets (ts_ms, interval_h, rate; REST v1/fundingInfo reconciled vs Vision, 0 mismatches, 125 settlements each) exist ONLY for BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT over the full window. The other 6 symbols carry September-only funding (manifest gap kind funding-terms-absent, Oct).
data_frozen.price_construction: 1-minute closes built causally from aggTrade parquet: close = last trade price in [m, m+60s); close_time = m+60s; minutes with zero trades are MISSING (no forward-fill, no interpolation). 1-hour close = last non-missing 1m close in the hour (= last trade of the hour); hours without any trade are MISSING.
data_frozen.warmup: Signal generation starts at window_start + 24h. P2 trailing may read settlements from 2026-09-01 (data start, causal); all entries/exits evaluated only inside the window.

costs_frozen.contract: cost-contract-v1 (src/cryptobot/costs.py): roundtrip = 2*(fee 5 + slippage 5) + spread 5 + funding 1 = 26 bps taker RT
costs_frozen.charge: 26 bps once per round trip, deducted from every cell's net
costs_frozen.label: conservative-simulation preset; live adverse selection typically worse (STUDY-01 note stands)

hypotheses_frozen.H-02: 8h funding settlements on BTC/ETH perps are large and persistent enough that a funding-informed hold collects net-positive carry after taker RT costs within the P2 family's stated turnover (~1/day).
hypotheses_frozen.H-03: 4h+ swing continuation on 1h bars clears the P3 80bps target after 26bps costs (costs <10% of the typical move, per the P3 preregistration).

p2_descriptive: Per-settlement rate distribution (bps): mean, median, p10, p90, min, max, fraction positive; annualized mean = mean_rate * 3 * 365 (fraction, reported as %).

Persistence: Pearson correlation between trailing-3-settlement mean rate and the NEXT settlement rate (settlements with 3 predecessors, inside window); plus sign-match rate P(next same sign as trailing mean).
Amortization arithmetic: funding_per_day_bps = mean_rate * 3 * 10^4; breakeven_hold_days = 26 / funding_per_day_bps (hold length at which collected funding alone covers one taker RT).

p2_signal_cells.trigger: trailing-3-settlement mean rate >= +T -> SHORT; <= -T -> LONG; T = 1.0 bp/8h = the venue baseline funding (0.01%/8h), declared a priori, not fitted
p2_signal_cells.entry: first 1m close with close_time >= settlement_ts + 60s (post-settlement, causal); entry_ts = that close_time
p2_signal_cells.exit: first 1m close with close_time >= entry_ts + H; H in {8h, 24h, 72h, 168h} — the long arms test the amortization claim directly and are declared a priori
p2_signal_cells.funding_attribution: settlements with entry_ts < s < exit_ts (strictly inside the hold; a settlement at the exit instant is conservatively excluded); SHORT collects +rate, LONG collects -rate per settlement
p2_signal_cells.one_position: per (symbol, side): a signal whose entry precedes the previous exit of the same cell is skipped and counted
p2_signal_cells.cells: primary: BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT x {LONG, SHORT} x {8h, 24h, 72h, 168h}; supplementary (labeled September-only, funding absent Oct): the other 6 symbols, same construction
p2_signal_cells.missing_data: entry/exit close missing in range -> cell skipped and counted; never imputed

p3_arithmetic_screen.per_symbol: N h-hour close-to-close returns; stdev bps; median |move| bps; p90 |move| bps; fraction of |moves| >= 26bps (cost-covering base rate); fraction >= 80bps (P3 target base rate)

p3_signal_cells.trigger: trailing-24h return (close_t / close_{t-24} - 1, both endpoints present) >= +100bps -> LONG; <= -100bps -> SHORT; threshold declared a priori at the order of the P3 80bps target
p3_signal_cells.entry: at the triggering 1h close (last trade of that hour; causal — trigger uses data up to and including that close)
p3_signal_cells.exit: 1h close at t + k, k in {4, 8, 24} matching H in {4h, 8h, 24h}; target bar missing -> skipped and counted
p3_signal_cells.one_position: per (symbol, side), overlapping signals skipped and counted

decision_rules_frozen.H-02: REJECTED-ON-THIS-DATA if every primary signal cell has net_mean <= 0; additionally, if breakeven_hold_days > 7 the perp-only taker funding-tilt at ~1/day turnover is rejected on arithmetic alone and the delta-neutral long-hold variant is flagged as requiring spot-leg data (separate study; Vision spot is $0) — not a candidate, not a capture justification by itself.
decision_rules_frozen.H-03: REJECTED-ON-ARITHMETIC if median |move| < 26bps at ALL of {4h, 8h, 24h} on BTC and ETH (the continuation premise cannot cover costs at any tested horizon); else REJECTED-ON-THIS-DATA if every primary signal cell net_mean <= 0; else MERITS-CANDIDATE-EVALUATION (owner decision, fresh data, full harness — NOT validation).
decision_rules_frozen.global: Whatever the outcome: NO candidate is created, NO strategy code changes, NO attempt-budget consumption, NO capture decision is made by this study — the output only informs the owner's choice with measured numbers.

posthoc_sensitivity_declared: Any threshold perturbations (P2 T in {0.5, 2.0} bp; P3 trigger in {50, 200} bps) are run separately, labeled POST-HOC in the report, and are never decision-relevant.
non_goals: No strategy/spec/code changes in any worker lane (W1 strategies/research, W2 market_data/execution, W3 risk/accounting untouched)
No live orders, no credentials, no network calls (repo-local data only)
No claim of profitability; descriptive economics only
No re-entry of S1-S5/X1 taker-scalp configs
